what: Two edits outside lane cargo's paths (from integrate-load's 01025): (1) root Cargo.toml:265-266 says blaze's one release subscriber is `crates/blaze-cargo/src/trace.rs`, which is deleted; v2's is blaze-profile's `Recorder`, installed by `blaze_profile::install` (crates/blaze-profile/src/lib.rs:221) from `blaze_cargo::cli::main`. Reword to: "blaze's one subscriber there, blaze-profile's recorder (crates/blaze-profile/src/lib.rs), takes INFO and above." (2) docs/cargo.md needs a v2 pass beyond integrate-load's fixes: the client's commands now also include `toolchain` and `doc` and `pack` (crates/blaze-cargo/src/cli.rs HELP is the list), a local registry's .crate is read in place (serve/fetch.rs), a package whose rust-version is newer than blaze's Rust is refused unless --ignore-rust-version, -vv shows dependencies' warnings (capped at warn), the sandbox keys per 01342. Lane cargo will review the text if asked.
